name: @impressive-ocr/desktop
//productName: Electron derives the app name — and therefore the userData directory — from this. Without it the scoped package name becomes AppData/Roaming/@impressive-ocr/desktop.
//author: electron-builder turns this into the Debian Maintainer field, which fpm refuses to synthesise. A bare name string is not enough - it needs the address too.
//desktopName: Matches Electron's app_id and StartupWMClass, so a running window is associated with its launcher entry instead of appearing as a second, nameless application.
